summary: Improve investment research, portfolio monitoring, and reporting with practical AI and digital workflows. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: AI-enabled digital productivity helps investment analysts, portfolio managers, and investment operations professionals improve research and reporting workflows. The course covers preparing portfolio data with Excel and Power Query, verifying research sources, drafting evidence-linked investment memos, and building portfolio monitoring workflows. It also addresses human review, approval points, and safeguards for confidential information, keeping analysts accountable for investment judgments.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for investment professionals who handle research, portfolio analysis, investment operations, and decision reporting. It suits intermediate-level practitioners who want to use AI and digital tools responsibly in day-to-day investment workflows. This course is designed for: Investment research analysts preparing company and sector research for review. Portfolio managers evaluating holdings, exposures, and investment recommendations. Investment operations analysts reconciling data and preparing recurring portfolio reports. Portfolio risk analysts tracking portfolio measures and escalating unusual movements. Equity research associates organizing source evidence and drafting investment notes. Fixed-income analysts comparing issuer information and preparing credit research summaries. Investment performance analysts preparing attribution inputs and performance commentary. Investment data analysts maintaining portfolio datasets and spreadsheet workflows. Investment compliance officers reviewing investment communication and information-handling controls. Chief investment office staff consolidating research and portfolio updates for leadership.
modules: Excel and Power Query Investment Data
Credit, Sukuk, Government Securities and Mandate Monitoring
Investment Productivity Action Plan and Reporting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with investment research, portfolio analysis, or investment operations is recommended. No programming or coding is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
